# TEZZ CONNECT

TEZZ CONNECT is a free, browser-based internet performance toolkit and Internet Knowledge Hub. It helps people measure their browser-to-edge connection, understand network behaviour, and troubleshoot everyday connectivity issues.

## Main tools
- [Free internet speed test](https://tezzconnect.online/): measure download and upload throughput, plus browser-based HTTP response timing and variation.
- [Internet Doctor](https://tezzconnect.online/internet-doctor): investigate slow or unstable connections with practical checks and explanations.
- [Network tools](https://tezzconnect.online/tools): explore browser-accessible network and connection diagnostics.
- [Global Network](https://tezzconnect.online/global-network): view aggregate regional measurements from participating TEZZ CONNECT tests when sample thresholds are met.
- [About TEZZ CONNECT](https://tezzconnect.online/about): read about the project, measurement approach, privacy and limitations.

## Knowledge Hub and guides
- [Internet Knowledge Hub](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/): browse practical internet, Wi-Fi and networking guides.
- [Internet speed explained: Mbps, download and upload](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/internet-speed-explained/): understand speed units, throughput and household requirements.
- [Latency, ping and jitter explained](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/latency-and-jitter/): understand response time, variation and packet loss.
- [Improve Wi-Fi speed](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/improve-wifi-speed/): practical Wi-Fi placement and troubleshooting advice.
- [Upload speed explained](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/upload-speed-explained/): understand upstream throughput and common uses.
- [Internet speed for gaming](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/internet-speed-for-gaming/): understand latency, jitter, packet loss and stable gameplay.
- [What is the internet?](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/what-is-the-internet/): learn how devices and networks connect.
- [How the internet works](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/how-the-internet-works/): follow a website request across a network.
- [Internet connection troubleshooter](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/connection-troubleshooter/): work through common connection symptoms.
- [Home network planner](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/home-network-planner/): explore router, mesh, access point and Ethernet layouts.
- [Networking buying guides](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/networking-buying-guides/): understand routers, mesh systems, extenders and switches.
- [Interactive network lab](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/interactive-network-lab/): explore network behaviour through interactive examples.
- [Internet learning roadmap](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/internet-learning-roadmap/): follow a structured beginner-to-advanced learning path.
- [Networking glossary](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/networking-glossary/): look up common internet and networking terms.
- [Home Wi-Fi security checkup](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/wifi-security-checkup/): review common router and wireless security settings.
- [Wi-Fi signal simulator](https://tezzconnect.online/guides/wifi-signal-simulator/): explore illustrative router placement and signal conditions.

## Measurement methodology and limitations
- Download and upload measurements run in the visitor's browser against TEZZ CONNECT endpoints. They estimate throughput between that browser/device and the TEZZ CONNECT network edge; they are not a guaranteed measurement of every route or service on the public internet.
- Latency and jitter figures use browser-based HTTP request-and-response timing to the TEZZ CONNECT network edge. They are not ICMP ping measurements.
- Results can vary with device performance, browser activity, Wi-Fi signal and interference, local network use, routing, test server conditions and network congestion.
- A speed test is a time-specific sample. Repeat tests under comparable conditions before drawing conclusions.
- Regional benchmark summaries use opt-in completed TEZZ CONNECT tests, require explicit consent, aggregate by country and region, cover a recent seven-day window, and display a region only when at least 30 samples are available.
- Benchmark data describes participating TEZZ CONNECT tests. It is not a census of all users, ISPs or networks and does not guarantee an individual's service quality.
- TEZZ CONNECT does not expose a public MCP or autonomous-agent execution API.
